items.name: Watermark Media Engine V2
items.title: Watermark Media Engine V2
items.description:
# Watermark Media Engine V2

**Protect your content and strengthen your brand with professional logo and text watermarks for both images and videos.**

Watermark Media Engine is a professional branding engine for **Core Factory V2** that automatically applies image logos and text watermarks to photos and videos in batch. Whether you're publishing content to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or building a media production pipeline, this engine helps ensure every file carries your visual identity.

Designed for automation, it supports recursive folder processing, customizable watermark styles, high-quality rendering, and seamless integration with Core Factory V2 Pipelines.

---

# Key Features

## Logo Watermarks

Apply your company logo or brand mark to every image and video automatically.

Supported features include:

* PNG, WebP, and common image formats
* Adjustable logo size
* Custom logo opacity
* Multiple placement positions
* Batch processing
* High-quality rendering

Perfect for protecting original content while increasing brand visibility.

---

## Text Watermarks

Add professional text overlays to both images and videos.

Customize every aspect of the watermark:

* Custom text
* Font selection
* Font size
* Font color
* Text opacity
* Stroke outline
* Shadow effects

Whether displaying your company name, website, copyright notice, or campaign message, text watermarks remain sharp and readable across different media formats.

---

## Flexible Positioning

Choose exactly where your watermark appears.

Supported positions include:

* Top Left
* Top Center
* Top Right
* Center Left
* Center
* Center Right
* Bottom Left
* Bottom Center
* Bottom Right

This flexibility allows branding that complements your content without distracting viewers.

---

## Process Images and Videos Together

Unlike tools limited to a single media type, Watermark Media Engine handles both images and videos within the same workflow.

Supported formats include:

### Images

* JPG
* JPEG
* PNG
* WebP
* BMP

### Videos

* MP4
* MOV
* AVI
* MKV
* WebM

This makes it ideal for mixed media libraries and multi-platform publishing.

---

## Batch Processing

Apply watermarks to hundreds or thousands of files automatically.

Features include:

* Recursive folder scanning
* Preserve folder structure
* Continue on error
* Overwrite control
* Progress reporting

Large media collections can be processed with a single job.

---

## Professional Rendering

Built using FFmpeg and Pillow to produce clean, high-quality output.

Features include:

* Sharp logo rendering
* Anti-aliased text
* Adjustable transparency
* Text outlines
* Shadow rendering
* Consistent results across different resolutions

Designed for production-quality branding without manual editing.

---

## Automation Ready

Watermark Media Engine integrates seamlessly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

Typical downstream workflows include:

* Media Transcode
* Aspect Ratio Conversion
* Subtitle Generation
* Video Compression
* Upload Automation
* Social Media Publishing
* Archive Management

Automatically watermark content before publishing or distribution without additional manual steps.

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Brand YouTube videos
* Add logos to TikTok and Instagram content
* Protect digital photography
* Watermark product images
* Add copyright notices
* Prepare marketing assets
* Publish branded training videos
* Build automated media production workflows

---

# Reliable Batch Processing

Designed for professional media production.

Features include:

* Worker-process execution
* Progress monitoring
* Cancellation support
* Structured JSON reports
* Continue-on-error processing
* Folder hierarchy preservation
* Predictable and repeatable output

Whether processing dozens or thousands of files, the engine delivers reliable results with minimal supervision.

---

# System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* FFmpeg
* Pillow
* Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)

---

# Why Choose Watermark Media Engine?

Adding watermarks manually is repetitive, time-consuming, and difficult to maintain across large media libraries.

Watermark Media Engine automates the entire branding process, allowing you to apply consistent logos and text overlays across images and videos while maintaining high visual quality.

Whether you're protecting copyrighted work, reinforcing your brand, or preparing media for large-scale publishing, this engine provides a fast, reliable, and production-ready watermarking solution.

---

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* YouTubers
* Social Media Managers
* Marketing Teams
* Photographers
* Video Editors
* Media Agencies
* Businesses publishing branded content

Protect your content. Strengthen your brand. Automate your watermarking with Watermark Media Engine V2.
